extracted.name: Cool Summer Cucumber and Tomato Toss
extracted.description: This balsamic-flavored tomato and cucumber salad boasts garden-fresh ingredients and simple seasonings for a spectacular summer side salad.
instruction_lines: Place cucumber and tomatoes in a bowl. Pour in olive oil and balsamic vinegar. Season with salt and pepper. Toss gently to coat. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
